snippet.description:
Returning to zero is not an option.

GODZILLA MINUS ZERO
VFX, Written, and Directed by Takashi Yamazaki

In theatres November 6
Follow @godzilla_toho and @GKIDSfilms for more updates!
godzillaminuszero.com

GODZILLA MINUS ZERO picks up in 1949, two years after the tumultuous events of Godzilla Minus One, and continues the story of the Shikishima family as they face an all-new calamity. 

As a project Filmed For IMAX, GODZILLA MINUS ZERO was shot with high-definition digital cameras certified by IMAX, and optimized in sound and imagery unique to IMAX screens. Fans can look forward to seeing Godzilla presented to all new terrifying heights, making GODZILLA MINUS ZERO a true cinematic event not to be missed.

snippet.title: Armand La Máquina- YO NO ERA ASÍ (Liryc video)
snippet.description:
YO NO ERA ASÍ – Armand La Máquina | Video Oficial

Yo no era así… la vida me cambió.

Esta canción cuenta la historia de alguien que creyó de verdad, amó con el corazón abierto y confió en personas que terminaron traicionándolo. Un amor falso, amigos que no eran reales y demasiadas heridas fueron cambiando al hombre que antes confiaba con los ojos cerrados.

No me volví malo.
Me volví más serio.
Más callado.
Más cuidadoso.

“YO NO ERA ASÍ” es un corrido tumbado de traición, desilusión y aprendizaje. Es para todos los que alguna vez dieron demasiado, confiaron en la gente equivocada y tuvieron que aprender, a la mala, que no todo el que te abraza es leal.

Si esta historia también habla de ti, deja tu comentario:

¿Qué fue lo que te cambió?

Suscríbete al canal y comparte esta canción con alguien que ya no es el mismo después de una traición.

🎵 Canción: YO NO ERA ASÍ
🎤 Artista: Armand La Máquina
🎬 Video Oficial

#YoNoEraAsí #ArmandLaMáquina #CorridoTumbado #MúsicaDeTraición

snippet.title: Dune: Part Three | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
“Forgive me for all I’ve done” Experience the epic conclusion. Dune: Part Three only in theaters and IMAX December 18. #DuneMovie#FilmedforIMAX

From Warner Bros. Pictures and Legendary Pictures comes Dune: Part Three, bringing Academy Award-nominated filmmaker Denis Villeneuve’s epic trilogy to a breathtaking conclusion.

Dune: Part Three is set nearly two decades after Paul Atreides seized control of the Imperium. Now a ruthless Emperor, Paul must face the consequences of his reign as old allies return, terrifying new threats emerge, and betrayal lurks in every shadow. Haunted by visions of Imperial collapse and the reappearance of his long-lost love, Paul is drawn into a sweeping conspiracy, with Chani at the heart of its unfolding mystery. As rebellion brews and enemies close in, Paul must confront the true cost of power and the fate of those he loves the most.

The film stars Oscar nominee Timothée Chalamet, Zendaya, Jason Momoa, Oscar nominee Florence Pugh, Rebecca Ferguson, Isaach de Bankolé, with Oscar nominee Charlotte Rampling, with Anya Taylor-Joy, and Robert Pattinson, and Oscar winner Javier Bardem.

Villeneuve directs from a screenplay by Villeneuve and Brian K. Vaughan, based on the novels written by Frank Herbert. The film is produced by Oscar nominees Mary Parent, Cale Boyter, Villeneuve and Tanya Lapointe, and Joe Caracciolo, and executive produced by Joshua Grode, Thomas Tull, Herbert W. Gains, Brian Herbert, Byron Merritt, Kim Herbert, Kevin J. Anderson, Richard P. Rubinstein, John Harrison and Jessica Derhammer.

Joining Villeneuve behind the camera are Oscar-winning director of photography Linus Sandgren, Oscar-winning production designer Patrice Vermette, Oscar-winning editor Joe Walker, Oscar nominated costume designer Jacqueline West, Oscar-nominated casting director Francine Maisler, and Oscar-winning composer Hans Zimmer.

Warner Bros. Pictures and Legendary Pictures Present A Legendary Pictures Production, A Film By Denis Villeneuve, Dune: Part Three, only in theaters and IMAX® across North America on December 18, 2026 and internationally beginning 16 December 2026. The film will be distributed worldwide by Warner Bros. Pictures and in China by Legendary East.

snippet.title: DON'T TURN ON THE LIGHT (Kinger's Song) Feat. Sean Chiplock from The Amazing Digital Circus
snippet.description:
STREAM #DontTurnOnTheLight ON SPOTIFY: https://open.spotify.com/album/3EPV6tUCbI172SvGUTlRW3?si=K89pYciRQiefF0Itwe8kYw

AND EVERYWHERE ELSE: https://ffm.to/kinger

MORE ORIGINAL MUSIC HERE: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PrMjrvz5hyc&list=PLv1P-6YxEm6AgF6yiKtydFevNQV4RxKn4&index=1

Another stellar video from the brilliant animation team at Giddy Goat Studios!! HUGE thanks to Sean for powering through this tongue-twister of a song! We wanted to capture the duality of Kinger's personality and create a lyrical and instrumental contrast between the chaos of his mind when the lights are on, and the reflective state he enters when the lights are off. Kinger is definitely one of my favorite characters from TADC, and we really hope we did his story justice!

SONG CREDITS:
Written by Gabe & Nate brown (Black Gryph0n & Baasik)
Produced by Nate Brown (Baasik): https://www.youtube.com/user/Baasikmusic

FEATURING:
Sean Chiplock (as Kinger): https://www.instagram.com/schiplock/
Gabriel Brown (as Kinger's inner voice): https://www.instagram.com/BlackGryph0n/

VIDEO CREDITS:

Claire M Corlett - Producer & Director
Katie Nelson - Producer & Director

Gabby Gillespie - 3D Animator
Bordin Sriwattana - 3D Animator
Logan McCloud - 3D Animator
Marah Wessendorf - 3D Animator

Michaela Pulizos - Storyboard Artist

Derek Gomen - Lighting & Rendering Artist

ZayJax - Character Rigs

Environment Assets by https://tadcworldpack.crd.co/

Wait... where am I?
What is this? *gasp*
Is that a microphone?

Something’s got control of me
That I can not explain
It’s like a billion bumble bees
Are buzzing in my brain

I think I should be worried
And I really don’t know why
But I feel it in my body
And I feel it in my mind

Kind of like I’ve been edited
By the thoughts inside my head
And I really wish I could run from it
But it’s running me instead

It’s like somebody’s flushing
My higher functions down the drain
I would think I’m going crazy
If I wasn’t so insane

Darkness...
Picking up the pieces
Drowning out the light
I suddenly remember her...
Everything about her
Makes me feel alive

WAIT! Don’t turn on the light!
(Light light light light light)
Don’t turn on the light
(Light light light light light)
Don’t turn on the...

I feel like I should know this place
I’ve seen it all before
But the only place I recognize
Is in my pillow fort

I wish I could remember
What I came out here to do
But how’s that even possible
When I can’t remember you

I hear 10,000 voices
And they’re all talking super loud
But at least I’m not hallucinating
Wait, is that a cow?

Feels like all my thoughts are leaking
Out of little holes inside my mind
And I haven’t had a memory
Since nineteen-something-nine

Darkness...
Picking up the pieces
Drowning out the light
I suddenly remember her...
Everything about her
Makes me feel alive

WAIT! Don’t turn on the light!
(Light light light light light)
Don’t turn on the light
(Light light light light light)
Don’t turn on the...

Sometimes I see things
A little more clearly
And though it’s all fleeting
I know I’m still me

I’m still here because she
Lives in my memory
And that makes me believe that
One day I’ll be free from the

Darkness
Picking up the pieces
Drowning out the light
I suddenly remember her
Everything about her
Makes me feel alive

Darkness
Picking up the pieces
Drowning out the light
I suddenly remember
Her
Everything about her
Makes me feel alive

- -- --- ---- ----- END ----- ---- --- -- -


Hello DDR’s (dedicated description readers)

Hasn't been too long this time, huh?! Let's see, what's happened since the last time we spoke... I got sick and lost my voice (which SUCKS because I have a LOT of stuff I need to record and I am not very patient, but it has given me a good excuse to work on my hobbies like flying and upgrading my plane, so that's been nice).

Claire turned 27 yesterday (HAPPY BIRTHDAY CLAIRE!!) We went shopping all day, then had beignets and opened presents with my family, so that was fun!

Oh yeah, and the Insane music video got taken down by Amazon! As frustrating as that was, we've actually been able to make some pretty good headway on that situation (big thanks to Viv and the SpindleHorse team for being so helpful and supportive of fan content)! I have high hopes we'll get the video back up soon, fingers crossed!

In the meantime, feel free to watch one of the many reuploads on other people's channels. That animation is far too good to be buried!!

Ok, I think that's it. Thank you all! Your love and support mean the world to us!

~Gabe

snippet.title: DOOMFLOW23 - Te Amaré En Silencio (Letra Oficial) 💔🎸
snippet.description:
💔 A veces la mayor prueba de amor es saber soltar y dejar ir... "Te Amaré En Silencio" es una canción dedicada a esas despedidas que duelen, pero que se hacen desde el corazón, deseándole lo mejor a esa persona especial aunque nuestros caminos se separen.

🎶 Disfruta de este nuevo tema de DOOMFLOW23, una fusión de sentimientos, guitarras, bongo y güira que te llegará directo al alma. ¡Puro Dumflow 23!

🔔 Si te gustó la canción, no olvides:
👍 Darle LIKE al video
💬 Dejar un COMENTARIO (¿A quién se la dedicarías?)
✅ SUSCRIBIRTE al canal y activar la campanita para más música.
📲 COMPARTIRLA con alguien que necesite escuchar esto.

👇 Letra Oficial / Lyrics: 👇
[Intro]
Buenas noches mi gente!
Puro Dumflow 23!

[Verso 1]
Si me quedo aquí a tu lado
Sé que te voy a estorbar
Yo sé que mi destino
Hoy es tenerte que soltar
Así que doy la media vuelta
Recojo todo y me voy
Pero en cada paso que dé
Me acordaré de lo que soy
Me llevo los recuerdos dulces
Me llevo lo que vivimos
Y esa magia tan cabrona
Que los dos construimos

[Coro]
Solo espero que la vida
Te trate con gran bondad
Que se te cumplan los sueños
Y encuentres la verdad
Te deseo mucha alegría
Te deseo mucho amor
Que en tu camino no haya frío
Ni tristezas ni dolor
No te guardo rencores
Te dejo libre pa' volar
Aunque a mí me toque el alma
En mil pedazos quebrar

[Post-Coro]
Y es que yo (y es que yo, y es que yo)
Siempre te voy a amar
No importa la distancia ni el tiempo que va a pasar
Te voy a amar
Mi reina, te lo juro por Dios
Aunque este maldito destino
Marque que hoy somos dos
A donde quiera que yo vaya
Mi corazón va contigo
Me despido como tu amor
Ya no puedo ser tu amigo

[Instrumental]
¡Epa!
¡Dale cintura, dale cintura!
¡Rómpele en esa guitarra, compa!
¡Que suene de verdad!

[Verso 2]
Te mereces a alguien
Que te dé lo que yo no puedo
Yo me trago las palabras y me enfrento a este miedo
Guárdame en un rinconcito de tu mente alguna vez
Que yo te amaré en silencio
Desde hoy a la vejez

[Coro]
Y es que yo (y es que yo, y es que yo)
Siempre te voy a amar...
No importa la distancia ni el tiempo que va a pasar
Te voy a amar
Mi reina, te lo juro por Dios
Aunque este maldito destino
Marque que hoy somos dos
A donde quiera que yo vaya
Mi corazón va contigo
Me despido como tu amor
Ya no puedo ser tu amigo

#Doomflow23 #TeAmareEnSilencio #MusicaLatina #Desamor

snippet.description:
Romeo Santos, Marc Anthony - Yo También
Romeo Santos, Marc Anthony - Yo También (Letra)

✅ Follow Romeo Santos
http://instagram.com/romeosantos
https://twitter.com/romeosantospage

https://www.instagram.com/godlyricsmusic?igsh=MTg2NTZ6d3Vtb2poMg==

Letra

[Letra de "Yo También"]

[Verso 1: Marc Anthony & Romeo Santos]
¿Quién eres tú para alardear y presumir?
Mejor pregúntale a ella
¿Quién es el hombre que la eleva a las estrellas?
¿Quién de los dos la hizo sentirse más mujer?
¿Quién eres tú para retarme a hacer de ella una competencia?
Así aseguro que es infame lo que alegas
Fui su éxtasis intenso de placer

[Pre-Coro: Marc Anthony & Romeo Santos]
Yo también la amé con mis locuras de poeta y moría por ella
Yo también le ofrecí un amor a lo Romeo y Julieta

[Coro: Marc Anthony & Romeo Santos]
Yo también la amé y le entregué el alma
Con una sonrisa alumbraba mis mañanas
Yo también sentí que ella fue mi todo
No solo pasión entre las sábanas mojadas

[Post-Coro: Marc Anthony]
Habla

[Verso 2: Romeo Santos]
¿Quién eres tú para sentirte superior, dueño de ella?
A ti te quiso, a mí me amó, algo deveras
Como Colón, yo navegué toda su piel

[Pre-Coro: Marc Anthony & Romeo Santos]
Yo también la amé con mis locuras de poeta y moría por ella
Yo también le ofrecí un amor a lo Romeo y Julieta

[Coro: Marc Anthony & Romeo Santos]
Yo también la amé y le entregué el alma
Con una sonrisa alumbraba mis mañanas
Yo también sentí que ella fue mi todo
No solo pasión entre las sábanas mojadas

[Puente: Marc Anthony & Romeo Santos]
¿Quién eres tú? (Tú, tú, tú)
Yo también solo vivía por ella
Y si la pedía, le conseguía la luna llena
Fui su amigo, un buen amante a su merced

[Interludio: Marc Anthony & Romeo Santos]
¡Aoh! ¡Chichí!
You need this in your life
(Yo también la amé)
Listen!
Lo mío fue puro sentimiento
Sobrenatural, algo perfecto
Yo lo entregué todo
(Yo también la amé)
Fueron mis caricias ardientes tan fuertes
Los besos calientes de miel
Que la dejaban ebria, soñando despierta
(Yo también la amé)
¡Ah-ah-ah-ah-ah-ah-ah-ah!
¡Oh-ah!
He's nasty (¡Oh-ho-ah!)
¡Ataca, Cucco!

[Outro: Marc Anthony & Romeo Santos]
(Yo) Descubrí sus emociones y mil aventuras
(Yo) Le entregaría la luna, todo por ella
(Yo) Un amor imparable, todo le di
(Yo) Fui su tierra, cielo y mar, la hice feliz
¡Puerto Rico!
¡La sangre me llama!

snippet.title: Surface - Closer Than Friends
snippet.description:
Surface's song Closer Than Friends is a smooth late 80s r&b ballad about a friendship gradually blossoming into love. With its polished quiet storm production and heartfelt vocals, Closer Than Friends emphasizes patience, trust and emotional connection over fleeting romance, making it one of the group's most enduring love songs.

Released as a single from the 1988 album 2nd Wave, Closer Than Friends became Surface's first No. 1 hit on Billboard's Hot Black Singles chart and remains one of the trio's signature recordings. Written by Bernard Jackson and David Townsend, Closer Than Friends helped establish Surface's reputation for sophisticated and melodic r&b.

Closer Than Friends reflects values associated with lasting relationships: patience, faithfulness and love that grows from genuine friendship. Its clean lyrics, sincere delivery, and timeless message have helped it remain a favorite among listeners who appreciate romance built on respect and emotional depth.

Surface Closer Than Friends Lyrics:

If you don't know how I feel for you
It's time I let all feelings show
I love you and I'll never let you go
No, baby

Right now we're just friends
But I pray someday you'll surrender
To love so tender i won't push you
As long as you know that my love is true

Get closer to you, baby (Hey)
Closer than just friends (I want to)

Closer than just friends how about you?
How about you?

It's hard to explain when you're close to me
I get a warm sensation inside

"Si quieres" es una de las obras más románticas y entregadas de Juan Gabriel. La canción es una declaración absoluta de amor, incondicionalidad y devoción.

A través de su letra, el "Divo de Juárez" expresa la disposición total de fundirse con el ser amado, ofreciendo no solo su amor, sino su tiempo, su vida y su protección, sin presiones ni exigencias ("si quieres"). Es un tema que habla de un amor maduro, generoso y profundamente tierno, donde la mayor felicidad es ver feliz a la otra persona.

snippet.title: Scary Things I CANT UNSEE in Mario!
snippet.description:
Today we are diving into some bizarre and slightly unsettling details in the Mario franchise that you will never be able to unsee. From creepy concept art and weird animation glitches to sprites that look completely different once you take a closer look, these are the strangest visuals hidden across the series. Watch as we uncover Luigi's twitching shoulders in Super Mario Galaxy 2, the terrifying original concept art for Toad from the 1993 live-action movie, and how Donkey Kong's mouth looks exactly like a cracked pistachio nut.

We also examine the layout of Sirena Beach matching a GameCube controller in Super Mario Sunshine, the hidden Bob-omb Battlefield map tucked away in Super Mario Odyssey, and the unsettling illusion that Yoshi's nose is completely fake. Whether it is Waluigi's cheap peeling hat logo in Super Mario Party or the definitive proof that Super Mario Bros. 3 is actually just a stage play, these hidden details and strange sprites will completely change how you view these classic Nintendo titles.
